name: Ritz Carlton Oahu, Turtle Bay
positioning: Oceanfront resort on Oahu's North Shore, officially The Ritz-Carlton O‘ahu, Turtle Bay, with oceanfront bungalows, several pools and seven beaches nearby
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort on the North Shore with wildlife and farm-to-table touches
Families who want pools with water slides and varied room types

facts.text: The Ocean Bungalows are steps from the beach and have a private pool, host service and luxe amenities.
The Ali‘i Suite is the most expansive accommodation at the hotel.
The Ocean Villas are steps from the main resort and have a full kitchen.
Interior designer Dianna Wong used organic fabrics, natural hardwoods and hand-woven carpets in the rooms.
The Ritz-Carlton Club offers private oceanfront lounge access, daily culinary presentations and concierge service.
Beach House by Roy Yamaguchi is at Kuilima Cove and serves family-favorite dishes created by chef Roy Yamaguchi.
The Nalu Spa is oceanside and has open-air treatment rooms.
The Adult Pool is an infinity-style pool with a hot tub and in-water loungers.
Seven secluded beaches are within walking distance of the resort.
A hotel opened on the site in 1972 as Del Webb’s Kuilima Resort Hotel & Country Club.

highlights.text: The Ocean Bungalow pool is a private Tranquility Pool exclusively for Ocean Bungalow guests.
The resort's Kuilima Farm grows many of the same fruits and vegetables that were cultivated in the traditional ahupua’a land division.
A kayak Turtle Tour crosses Kawela Bay's calm waters to spot marine life, including honu (Hawaiian green sea turtles).
Paniolo, A Hawaiian Cowboy Lūʻau is a weekly dinner show at the resort's Stables.
The Keiki Pool has two water slides.

considerations.text: Restaurants, boutiques and food trucks are in Haleiwa town, about 20 minutes away, and there is not much nightlife.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the service as more laid-back and less formal than typically expected from a Ritz-Carlton.
WhataHotel notes the location is remote from Honolulu's main attractions.
